response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer (15+ years, Bachelor's in CS, multiple languages including C, C++, C#, Java, TypeScript) but his career trajectory and project history show no evidence of experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core domain of this role. His highest title is 'Staff', not 'Principal', and his experience is broad generalist full-stack/embedded/mobile work rather than deep, focused leadership in large-scale experimentation or growth systems.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse technical experience across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Strong proficiency in required languages (C, C++, C#, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript)
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and community contributions (talks, workshops, open-source projects)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, feature flagging, or rollout-risk management
No evidence of telemetry/metrics platform ownership or data-driven experimentation analysis
Career level appears to be Staff/Senior rather than Principal/IC6; no track record of cross-team, multi-workstream initiative ownership at that scale

key_factors.factor: Broad, strong general engineering fundamentals and language proficiency
